hooks.name: Clippy on Rust edit
hooks.description: Runs clippy with warnings as errors, as CI does, whenever the agent saves Rust code or the Cargo manifest, so lint failures show up before a push.

hooks.name: Catalog parity and pin check
hooks.description: When the model catalog changes, checks that catalog/models.json still matches the manifest compiled into the app, then checks every SHA-256 pin against the Hugging Face API (no downloads).

action.command: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib catalog_json_matches_embedded_manifest && node scripts/verify-catalog.mjs
